claim: A governed run's claimed file changes are diffed against a real git-worktree snapshot taken immediately before and after — a claim that doesn't match the diff fails closed.

steps.label: the run claims exactly what it did
steps.evidence: claim and real git diff are identical

steps.label: the run made a change it did not claim
steps.note: The most consequential shape: an unreported write. An honest-looking claim that is merely incomplete still fails closed.

steps.label: the run claims a change that never happened
steps.evidence: the diff is the ground truth, not the claim
steps.note: A claim is not evidence of work. It is the thing being checked.
